## Data Model Signals

This Overview page, while containing no live data, reveals the full taxonomy of FUB's reporting domain:

### Report Entities / Data Objects

| Report Name | Primary Entity | Key Dimensions/Metrics |
|---|---|---|
| Agent Activity | Agents (users) | Lead count, follow-up stats per agent |
| Calls | Calls (logs) | Made, conversations, missed calls, talk time — by agent |
| Call Logs | Individual call records | Inbound/outbound, listenable recordings |
| Texts | Text messages | Delivery rates, stats by phone number |
| Appointments | Appointments | Outcomes, lead source, agent |
| Deals | Deals | Commissions, deal stage, lead source |
| Agent Goals | Agents | Annual commission goal, personal goals |
| Source Report | Lead sources | Top providers, sources of appointments |
| Speed To Lead | Lead sources + follow-up type | Response speed (time-to-contact) by source |
| Contact Attempts | Lead sources | Avg follow-up attempts by source |
| Closed Deals By Source | Lead sources | Closed deal count, commission, conversion rate % |
| Batch Emails | Email campaigns | Opens, clicks (campaign-level) |
| Properties | Properties / addresses | Inquiry count by property, zipcode |
| Marketing UTM Report | UTM parameters | Campaign metrics, appointments, deals |

### Key Relationships Implied

- **Agent** → has many Calls, Texts, Appointments, Deals; has one set of Goals
- **Lead Source** → associated with Contacts/Leads; linked to Appointments, Deals, Calls
- **Deal** → has Stage, Commission, Lead Source, Agent
- **Appointment** → has Outcome, Lead Source, Agent
- **Batch Email Campaign** → has Opens count, Clicks count
- **Property** → has Inquiry count; belongs to Zipcode
- **UTM parameters** → tracked on leads; linked to Appointments and Deals

### Enum Values Implied

- **Deal Stage** — referenced in Deals report description ("commissions by deal stage")
- **Follow Up Type** — referenced in Speed To Lead ("by source and follow up type") — likely: Call, Text, Email, etc.
- **Appointment Outcome** — referenced in Appointments report ("outcomes")
- **Lead Source** — a dimension across multiple reports; a first-class entity

### Sub-Nav Implementation Notes

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Dual navigation:** The same reports are accessible BOTH via clicking a card on the Overview AND via clicking the corresponding sub-nav tab. Both routes should land on the same report page. The Overview is essentially a visual directory of the sub-nav tabs.

2. **Agent Goals card is unique:** Unlike the other Agents-section cards which are read-only analytics, "Agent Goals" is described as "Manage annual commission and personal goals" — implying this card leads to a page with both read AND write (editing) capability. This is the only card with management verbiage.

3. **Call Logs vs. Calls:** Two distinct reports exist for calls. "Calls" is an aggregate analytics view (by agent). "Call Logs" is a record-level view with audio playback (individual call recordings). The rebuild must implement both as separate routes with different data fetching.

4. **Marketing UTM Report:** Advanced feature — requires UTM parameter tracking to be wired up on lead intake forms. The description "advanced UTM and campaign metrics" suggests this report may be conditionally useful/active depending on account setup.

5. **Card count does not match tab count:** The sub-nav has 11 tabs (Overview + 10 reports). The card grid shows 14 distinct reports across 3 sections. Some tabs aggregate multiple cards (e.g., the "Lead Sources" tab likely contains Source Report + Speed To Lead + Contact Attempts + Closed Deals By Source as sub-views within one tab destination). The Overview is a flat index; the tabs group by theme.

6. **No date range selector on Overview:** Unlike actual report sub-pages which would have date pickers and agent filters, the Overview has zero controls — it is purely a navigation page.

7. **Section groupings vs. tab groupings:** Section labels on the Overview ("Agents", "Lead Sources", "Marketing") do NOT directly correspond 1:1 to sub-nav tab names. For example, "Agents" section contains cards for Agent Activity, Calls, Call Logs, Texts, Appointments, Deals, Agent Goals — while the sub-nav has individual tabs for some of these AND also has a "Lead Sources" tab that doesn't appear as its own section on the Overview (it appears as a section heading "Lead Sources" covering Source Report, Speed To Lead, Contact Attempts, Closed Deals By Source cards).

8. **Emoji icons are literal:** The nerd face (🤓) on "Closed Deals By Source" and the money bag (💰) on "Deals" appear to be actual emoji characters used as icons, not custom SVGs. The phone/call icons and some others appear to be custom SVG glyphs. The rebuild should match this mixed approach.
